candidates.title: A picked video is sent in one request that the server cuts after 5 minutes, with no resume
evidence: webapp:client/src/lib/selfCaptureVideo.ts:115-160 the whole file in one XMLHttpRequest POST, client timeout 15 min, no parts or resume
webapp:server/index.ts:5 http.createServer with no requestTimeout set (grep requestTimeout in server/: no match); .nvmrc = 22
cmd: node slowpost.mjs (scratch; default http.createServer on node v22.23.5, a 400 MB POST at about 640 KB/s) -> 'requestTimeout 300000', 'response 408 after s 330.011' with about 210 MB sent
webapp:server/routes/self-capture-uploads.ts:128,146-147 the route accepts up to 2 GiB
candidates.today: When a site picks a saved video instead of filming in the page, the browser sends the whole file in one request. Node 22 closes any request not fully received within 300 seconds, and the server does not change that. At a 10 Mbit/s phone uplink that is about 375 MB; at 5 Mbit/s about 190 MB. A longer upload fails and starts from zero on retry. A network drop or a closed tab also loses the whole upload.
candidates.should: A picked video uploads in parts like the in-page recording does, and a retry resumes from the last stored part.
candidates.proposal: Smallest fix today: set server.requestTimeout = 0 (or 30 min) for the upload route in server/index.ts so long uploads are not cut. Then send picked files through the existing parts route (/:token/parts/:index and /parts/complete, already used by CaptureRecorder) and use the existing GET /:token/parts to skip stored parts.
candidates.user_result: A site on an ordinary phone connection can post a 1-2 minute video it already filmed.
candidates.risk: Longer-held connections on the single web instance; the parts route already exists and is tested by the recorder.
candidates.verify_how: Measured on a bare Node 22 server with the same defaults as server/index.ts (408 at 330 s). Not measured end to end through Render's proxy; a real phone upload of a 500 MB file to a staging deploy would settle it.
candidates.requirement_source: doctrine 'video in'; the single-request design has source nobody
